question: Who among the following was honoured with Bharat Ratna award before becoming the President of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**S Radhakrishnan**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan was honored with the Bharat Ratna in 1954, before becoming the President of India in 1962.**
 
• Dr. Radhakrishnan **was an acclaimed philosopher and an expert on Indian philosophy. **
 
• His works helped bridge Eastern and Western philosophical traditions.
 
• His birthday, September 5, is celebrated as **Teachers' Day** in India to honor his contributions to education and his belief in the value of teaching.
 
• **Before becoming President, he served as the first Vice President of India (1952–1962).**
 
• **He also represented India as an ambassador to UNESCO and the Soviet Union.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rajendra Prasad****​**

 
 
• Rajendra Prasad was the longest-serving President of India (1950 to 1962).
 
• Rajendra Prasad was elected as the first President of India on 24th January 1950
 
• He was one of the prominent leaders of the Indian independence movement and played a prominent role as the President of the Indian National Congress. 
 
 
• During his tenure, H.C. Mookerjee was the Vice-President.
 
 
 
• ​He was a lawyer by profession, and also an influential leader during the Indian freedom struggle.
 
• He served as the president of the Constituent Assembly that drafted the first constitution of the Republic of India, which lasted from 1948 to 1950.
 
• He also became the first Minister of Food and Agriculture in 1946 in the Interim National Government.
 
 
 
• V. V. Giri:
 
 
• Varahagiri Venkata Giri was the 4th president of India from 24 August 1969 to 24 August 1974.
 
• He was the only president to be elected as an independent candidate.
 
• He was succeeded by Fakhruddin Ali Ahmed as president in 1974.
 
• After the end of his full term, Giri was honored by the Government of India with the Bharat Ratna in 1975.
 
• V. V. Giri was closely associated with the labor and trade union movement in India throughout his career.
 
• V. V. Giri was a founding member of the All India Railwaymen's Federation which was formed in 1923 and served as its general secretary for over a decade.
 
• He was elected president of the All India Trade Union Congress for the first time in 1926.
 
• V. V. Giri also founded the Bengal Nagpur Railway Association and in 1928 led the workers of the Bengal Nagpur Railway in a non-violent strike for the rights of retrenched workers.
 
 
 
• **Pranab mukherjee****​**
 
 
• Pranab Mukherjee served as 13th President of India from 25th July 2012 till 25th July 2017.
 
• He was honoured with India's highest civilian honour, the Bharat Ratna in 2019 by incumbent President Ram Nath Kovind.
 
• Mukherjee had served as the Defence Minister from 2004-2006, External Affairs from 2006-2009, and the Union Minister of Finance from 2009 to 2012 before he was elected President.
 
• The Prime Minister PV Narasimha Rao appointed Mukherjee as the head of the Planning Commission in 1991 and Foreign Minister in 1995.
